place-search.searching.meaning: Says inside the open place autocomplete list that Geoapify results are loading.

place-search.rate-limited.meaning: Says inside the open place autocomplete list that the account hit the place-search rate limit and free-text typing still works.
place-search.rate-limited.text: Too many searches for now. You can keep typing the place directly.

place-search.place-selected.meaning: Says below Behavior Place that a place suggestion was chosen, with Undo beside it.

place-search.place-selected-with-marker.meaning: Says below Behavior Place that a specific Geoapify place was chosen and its completion marker will save when the Behavior saves, with Undo beside it.
place-search.place-selected-with-marker.text: Selected {title}. Its marker will save when you save this behavior.

place-search.home-selected.meaning: Says below Settings Home that a place suggestion was chosen and will save on Enter or blur, with Undo beside it.
place-search.home-selected.text: Selected {title}. Press Enter or leave the field to save.

place-search.home-selected-with-marker.meaning: Says below Settings Home that a specific Geoapify place was chosen and its Home completion marker will save when Home saves, with Undo beside it.
place-search.home-selected-with-marker.text: Selected {title}. Press Enter or leave the field to save. Its Home marker will save with it.

place-search.home-updated.meaning: Says below Settings Home that the selected address saved, with Undo beside it.

place-search.home-updated-with-marker.meaning: Says below Settings Home that the selected address and its Home completion marker saved, with Undo beside it.
place-search.home-updated-with-marker.text: Home and its marker updated from selection.
